details.biography:
Richard Roberts is an Australian-born set decorator. He built a reputation in Hollywood through his contributions to major tentpole movies, serving as set decorator on Guardians of the Galaxy (2014), Avengers: Age of Ultron (2015), Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi (2017), Dune: Part One (2021), and Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania (2023).

His excellence in design has been recognized by his peers: Roberts served as a set decorator on the pilot episode “A Golden Crown” of Game of Thrones, which won the Art Directors Guild Award for Excellence in Production Design for a One-Hour Period or Fantasy Single-Camera Series.
details.name: Richard Roberts
